summary: Group Portrait is a 1991 compilation album by the American band Chicago, released by Columbia Records and Legacy Recordings and later reissued on the band's Chicago Records label. It collects hits and album cuts from the band's first fourteen albums along with rare tracks.
one_line: Group Portrait is a 1991 compilation album by the rock band Chicago gathering hits, album cuts and rarities.
key_facts: Group Portrait is a compilation album by the American band Chicago.
Group Portrait was originally released by Columbia Records and Legacy Recordings.

Group Portrait also includes rare tracks.
